entities.name: Luis Díez del Corral
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Díez del Corral y Pedruzo was a Spanish jurist, writer and political scientist. He was legal counsel and a deputy in the Spanish Cortes from 1943–49, during the first legislative sessions of the Franco Period and was the chief of the "Section for Corporate and Social Management" of the Institute for Political Studies.

entities.name: Luis Díez del Corral
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Díez del Corral y Pedruzo was a Spanish jurist, writer and political scientist. He was legal counsel and a deputy in the Spanish Cortes from 1943–49, during the first legislative sessions of the Franco Period and was the chief of the "Section for Corporate and Social Management" of the Institute for Political Studies.
